AdCellerant LLC Term A Loan fair value is shown under the Fair Value column as $ 3,402,088.

findings.detail: FX02 treated the internal standard USD unit token as non-USD even though the raw fair value cells are dollar-denominated.

rationale: This is a Class 1 currency/unit check on fair_value_currency. The flagged value is an internal token named UNIT_STANDARD_USD_KQJVLDFGZ0E38P0J92LZQA, and the raw investment schedule prints the fair value column in dollars for representative flagged holdings. Source rows 10:6, 10:15, and 10:20 show fair values preceded by '$', so the source supports USD denomination and the FX02 fire is a normalization/check false alarm rather than a true non-USD fair value.
